decisions.evidence: Both alternatives are annotated 4-aminobutyrate aminotransferase: Sama_2636 (next to succinate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase Sama_2637) and Sama_3606 (class III/GABA aminotransferase). Same-name paralogs, so both are kept.

The rule already joins the ALS III subunits (Sama_2018 catalytic and Sama_2019 regulatory) and the ALS II subunits (Sama_3281 catalytic and Sama_3280 regulatory) as AND complexes. No change is needed.

Sama_1628 and Sama_3011 are same-name paralogs ('bifunctional N-succinyldiaminopimelate-aminotransferase/acetylornithine transaminase'), so both are kept.

Alternatives are two 'outer membrane porin, putative' genes (Sama_1251, Sama_3336) plus Sama_3096 'OmpA family protein' (RefSeq YiaD-family OmpA-like lipoprotein, 222 aa). The porins that would remain carry only generic annotations, so R1 is not allowed; this is a diffusion step and the OR redundancy is unaffected.
Sama_0946 is NagA (N-acetylglucosamine-6-phosphate deacetylase). Sama_0028 has a family-level 'amidohydrolase' annotation, which must not be removed.
Sama_0260 is argininosuccinate lyase (ArgH, EC 4.3.2.1), which catalyses the next step, not this reaction. Keep Sama_0259 'argininosuccinate synthase' (ArgG, EC 6.3.4.5), the only ArgG in the genome.

All four alternatives are aspartate kinases: Sama_0603 (AK III), Sama_1049 (aspartate kinase), Sama_0905 (bifunctional AK I/HSD I) and Sama_3170 (bifunctional AK II/HSD II). These are genuine isozymes.

No cellobiose phosphorylase is annotated. Sama_2451 'phosphorylase' lies in the glycogen operon (Sama_2449-2454), so it is glycogen phosphorylase. Beta-glucosidases Sama_1402 and Sama_1404 are hydrolytic, not phosphorolytic.
Both alternatives carry chorismate mutase domains: Sama_0894 (bifunctional CM/prephenate dehydrogenase, TyrA) and Sama_0898 (CM/prephenate dehydratase, PheA-type). These are genuine isozymes.
The only match is Sama_0837 'citrate transporter'. Its annotation states neither metal-citrate:H+ symport nor any metal specificity, so it is not an exact annotation for Mn2+-citrate uptake.
The only match is Sama_0837 'citrate transporter'. Its annotation states neither metal-citrate:H+ symport nor any metal specificity, so it is not an exact annotation for Zn2+-citrate uptake.
No citrate:H+ antiporter or citrate exporter is annotated. Sama_0837 'citrate transporter' does not specify export by proton antiport.

Sama_1194 (Gfo/Idh/MocA oxidoreductase) and Sama_2231 (fructokinase) are enzymes, not outer-membrane channels. However, the porins that would remain (Sama_1251, Sama_3336) carry only generic annotations, so R1 is not allowed; the OR redundancy is unaffected.

No Cu2+ uptake permease is annotated. Sama_1786 is a copper-translocating P-type ATPase (CopA-type, ATP-driven export), and CorA Sama_1537 is a Mg/Co transporter. Neither annotation fits this reaction.
Sama_1508 is CysK (cysteine synthase A). Sama_1824 has a family-level annotation ('PLP-dependent cysteine synthase family protein'), which must not be removed.
Sama_0657, Sama_0893 and Sama_2074 are same-name paralogs, all annotated 'phospho-2-dehydro-3-deoxyheptonate aldolase' (DAHP synthase). These are genuine isozymes.

Sama_2221 is pterin-4a-carbinolamine dehydratase (PhhB, EC 4.2.1.96, 112 aa), in the phhA operon, a different activity. Keep Sama_3279 'dihydroxy-acid dehydratase' (IlvD, EC 4.2.1.9) in the ilv cluster.

Sama_1908 is DapA. Sama_1531 is annotated 'dihydrodipicolinate synthetase family protein' (RefSeq '4-hydroxy-tetrahydrodipicolinate synthase'). That annotation is compatible/family-level, so it must not be removed, even though the gene sits in a hydroxyproline-catabolism cluster.
Sama_2824 is FolA. Sama_1764 has a family-level 'short-chain dehydrogenase/reductase SDR' annotation (possibly a FolM-type reductase), which must not be removed.

Sama_0829 'dihydroneopterin aldolase' (FolB, EC 4.1.2.25) names exactly this enzyme. It is adjacent to Sama_0830 HPPK (FolK), the next folate step. Sama_1489 FolX acts on the triphosphate and is not included.
Sama_0840 is aspartate carbamoyltransferase (PyrB, EC 2.1.3.2), the preceding pyrimidine step, not a dihydroorotase. Keep Sama_2870 'dihydroorotase' (PyrC, EC 3.5.2.3).
Sama_1736 is 30S ribosomal protein S1, a translation protein. Keep Sama_0927 '4-hydroxy-3-methylbut-2-enyl diphosphate reductase' (IspH).

Sama_2559 is PanE (2-dehydropantoate 2-reductase). Sama_3282 is ketol-acid reductoisomerase (IlvC), which has a documented ketopantoate-reductase side activity, so it is treated as a broad-specificity alternative and kept.
Both alternatives are fumarate hydratases (class II FumC Sama_0822; class I FumA/B-type Sama_1688). These are genuine isozymes.
All three alternatives (Sama_0494 ArsJ-associated, Sama_1806, Sama_1808) are annotated glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase. Same-name paralogs, so all are kept.

Sama_0945 is RefSeq 'glucosamine-6-phosphate deaminase NagB-II' (EC 3.5.99.6); its FB 'GFAT' name is outdated. It is only 332 aa, lacking the glutamine-amidotransferase domain of the 609-aa GlmS, and sits with nagA Sama_0946. Keep Sama_3639 GlmS (next to glmU Sama_3642).
Both alternatives are annotated glutamine synthetase / glutamate--ammonia ligase (Sama_3416; Sama_1174, GS family). The annotations are compatible, so both are kept.
Both alternatives are outer membrane porins (Sama_1251, Sama_3336). There is no non-catalyst to remove.
The rule is Sama_1642 carbonate dehydratase OR spontaneous. CO2 hydration is genuinely spontaneous, so there is nothing to join or remove.
Both alternatives are bifunctional aspartokinase/homoserine dehydrogenases (ThrA-type Sama_0905, MetL-type Sama_3170). These are genuine isozymes.
Sama_1736 is 30S ribosomal protein S1, a translation protein. Keep Sama_0927 '4-hydroxy-3-methylbut-2-enyl diphosphate reductase' (IspH).
No maltose/maltodextrin ABC transporter (MalEFGK) or other maltose-specific transporter is annotated in genes.tsv.
Sama_1301 is Ndk. Sama_1315 is adenylate kinase, which has a documented NDP-kinase side activity, so it is treated as a broad-specificity alternative and kept.
Sama_1301 is Ndk. Sama_1315 is adenylate kinase, which has a documented NDP-kinase side activity, so it is treated as a broad-specificity alternative and kept.
Sama_1742 is a 181-aa 'hypothetical protein' (RefSeq 'DUF2058 domain-containing protein') with no enzymatic annotation. Keep Sama_3635 'naphthoate synthase' (MenB).
The rule is Sama_0336 3-isopropylmalate dehydrogenase (LeuB) OR spontaneous. Decarboxylation of this beta-keto acid is genuinely spontaneous/LeuB-associated, so there is nothing to remove.

Sama_0956 and Sama_2243 are same-name phosphoglucosamine mutase paralogs. Sama_1706, a phosphoglucomutase, is in the same phosphohexomutase superfamily and may have broad specificity, so there is no clear non-catalyst.
Sama_1706 is phosphoglucomutase. Sama_0381 is a sugar phosphatase (2-deoxyglucose-6-phosphatase/HxpB), and phosphatases must not be removed.

Sama_2016 is FB 'GntR family transcriptional regulator' but RefSeq 'aminotransferase-like domain-containing protein' (family-level aminotransferase). Aminotransferase redundancy is plausible: a second aromatic aminotransferase, Sama_1733, is in the genome.

Sama_1859 'phosphomethylpyrimidine kinase/thiamine-phosphate diphosphorylase' (ThiD-ThiE fusion) names HMP-P kinase (EC 2.7.4.7), exactly this reaction. It sits in the thiC-thiF-thiS-thiG-thiH cluster (Sama_1855-1860).

Sama_0598 is the inorganic pyrophosphatase Ppa. Sama_1041 (SurE 5'/3'-nucleotidase) and Sama_2012 ('Ppx/GppA phosphatase family protein') are phosphatases, which the procedure says must not be removed.

Alternatives are two 'outer membrane porin, putative' genes (Sama_1251, Sama_3336) plus Sama_3096 'OmpA family protein' (RefSeq YiaD-family OmpA-like lipoprotein, 222 aa). The porins that would remain carry only generic annotations, so R1 is not allowed; this is a diffusion step and the OR redundancy is unaffected.
Sama_1647 is DapE. Sama_1565 is FB 'hypothetical protein' but RefSeq 'dipeptidase', a broad-specificity hydrolase annotation, so it is not an unannotated hypothetical and must not be removed.

Sama_1184 is RefSeq 'olefin beta-lactone synthetase' (OleC, EC 6.1.3.1; FB 'peptide synthase') in the oleABCD cluster (Sama_1182-1185), a different activity. Keep Sama_3463 'O-succinylbenzoic acid--CoA ligase' (MenE), in the menD/menH/menC cluster.

Sama_1384 is a 'streptogramin A acetyl transferase' (Vat-family antibiotic O-acetyltransferase), with a different acyl donor and substrate class. Keep Sama_1136 '2,3,4,5-tetrahydropyridine-2,6-dicarboxylate N-succinyltransferase' (DapD).

Sama_2431 is ThiI (tRNA uracil 4-sulfurtransferase / thiazole sulfur transfer, EC 2.8.1.4), not a kinase. Keep model gene WP_041410146_1, RefSeq 'thiamine-phosphate kinase' (ThiL; probably Sama_1021 in genes.tsv, unmapped in the packet).
Sama_0831 is BacA/UppP. Sama_0148 and Sama_3275 are PAP2-family phosphatases (PgpB-like) that can dephosphorylate undecaprenyl diphosphate, and phosphatases must not be removed.
Sama_1735 is cytidylate kinase (Cmk, (d)CMP-specific NMP kinase, EC 2.7.4.25), a different specific activity. Keep Sama_1141 'uridylate kinase' (PyrH, EC 2.7.4.22), the only PyrH in the genome.
